title: The sidebar orders workspaces by what their agents need
body:
Once agents report their state (see the blocking issue), Jack wants a simple, text-only way to see which workspaces need him, with no thumbnails. The Super+Tab picker shows workspaces as scaled-down panes, in Jack's order.

## Proposal

The sidebar from the frame issue lists every workspace by agent state: attention first, then done, then working, then idle, then none. Within a state the picker's order holds. The top bar shows the count in each state. A key jumps to the next workspace in attention.

## Open

- Which key jumps to the next workspace in attention.
- Keyboard navigation inside the sidebar.
